corrected_behavior: Only literal values, earlier definitions and builtin syscall constants are valid definition values
Builtin syscall names are reserved; labels and definitions cannot redeclare one another, including on the same line
Definition names cannot be numeric or quoted literals
The host accepts syscall aliases and same-line labels on definitions, matching existing valid RTL behavior
Unused definitions still enforce the documented 32-bit value bounds
